name: @educateos/ocs
description: EducateOS Open Course Specification (roadmap §5.3 and §15.10, PR C06): the OCS course package contract (manifest, units, activities, resources, Codex, lockfile), a deterministic module resolver, the composer that flattens a locked course into one outline, friendly composition for teachers, the export to curriculum activity installations, the Thin CC adapter in both directions, publisher signatures against district-approved keys, and an immutable Durable Object SQLite library through its `./durable-object-library` entry point. A library, not a deployable Worker. See docs/educateos/rfc/0001-open-course-specification.md.
